Base Mitigation: All services within the Azure Trust Boundary must authenticate all incoming requests, including requests coming from the same network. Proper authorizations should also be applied to prevent unnecessary privileges.
Model Mitigation:
• Digitally sign telemetry payloads using ECDSA keys stored in Azure IoT Edge Device Provisioning Service
• Implement schema validation at ingestion point via Azure Event Grid filters
• Configure Application Insights ingestion-time sampling with anomaly detection thresholds
